tools.name: refresh_auth
tools.description: Refresh Fusebase authentication cookies by re-launching a Playwright browser session. Use this when other tools return 401/auth errors. Set interactive=true to open a visible browser window for manual login. Returns cookie age and expiry info.

tools.name: list_agent_profiles
tools.description: List all configured agent authentication profiles found in the local data directory, showing profile names, cookie age in hours, and status.

tools.name: switch_active_profile
tools.description: Switch the active default agent authentication profile for subsequent tool calls in this session.

tools.name: check_session_health
tools.description: Inspect the health, age, validity, and organization access of the current session or a specific agent profile without launching a browser. Returns status (HEALTHY/WARNING/EXPIRED), auth mode (DIRECT_TOKEN/HYBRID/SESSION_COOKIE), and active workspaces.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List all workspaces in your Fusebase organization with their IDs, titles, and colors. Use this first to discover workspace IDs needed by most other tools.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List pages (notes) in a Fusebase workspace with titles, types, and metadata. Supports pagination and filtering by folder. Returns compact summaries — use get_page for full details on a specific page.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific page including title, dates, size, sharing status, and emoji. Returns all properties — use this when you need full page info beyond what list_pages provides.

tools.name: get_recent_pages
tools.description: Get recently accessed pages in a workspace, sorted by last access time. Useful for finding what the user was last working on. Returns up to the specified limit (default 10).

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new page in a Fusebase workspace with the given title. Optionally provide initial content via 'markdown' (recommended) or structured 'blocks'. Optionally specify a folderId to place it in a specific folder (defaults to root). Returns the created page's metadata including its new globalId.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update a page or folder's properties — rename it, move it to a different folder, or both. Uses the upsert endpoint so partial updates are safe.

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: [DESTRUCTIVE] Delete a page permanently from a workspace. This action is irreversible — the page and its content will be lost. Use get_page first to verify you have the correct page before deleting.

tools.name: move_page
tools.description: Move a page to a different folder within the workspace, move it back to workspace root, or migrate it to an entirely different workspace. Specify targetWorkspaceId to migrate across workspaces, and/or folderId (or parentId) to move between folders.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List all folders in a Fusebase workspace as a nested tree structure. Each folder includes its children, icons, and sharing status. Use folder IDs to filter list_pages or as parentId when creating pages.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in a Fusebase workspace for organizing pages. Can be created at the root or nested inside an existing parent folder.

tools.name: get_page_attachments
tools.description: Get all attachments (images, files, audio recordings) embedded in a specific page. Returns file names, MIME types, sizes, and UUIDs. Useful for auditing media content or finding downloadable assets.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List all uploaded files across a workspace with names, sizes, formats, and URLs. Supports pagination with limit and offset. Different from get_page_attachments — this covers workspace-wide file storage.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file to a FuseBase page. The file content must be provided as base64-encoded data. Returns the attachment ID and URL path. Use get_page_attachments to list existing attachments.

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Download a file attachment from a FuseBase page. Supports native MCP image rendering, local file downloading to disk (saving LLM context), or base64 data. Use get_page_attachments to find attachment IDs first.

tools.name: get_tags
tools.description: Get all tags in a workspace, or tags for a specific page if pageId is provided. Workspace tags return the full tag vocabulary; page tags return only tags applied to that page. Use update_page_tags to modify a page's tags.

tools.name: update_page_tags
tools.description: Set tags on a specific page, replacing any existing tags entirely. Pass an array of tag strings to apply. To remove all tags, pass an empty array.

tools.name: get_members
tools.description: Get members of a workspace or the entire organization if workspaceId is omitted. Workspace members include roles and privileges; org members include user profiles with emails. Useful for finding collaborators or checking permissions.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Get the content of a page decoded from its Y.js document via WebSocket sync. By default returns semantic HTML. Set format='markdown' for clean, compact markdown that uses ~50% fewer tokens.

tools.name: append_page_content
tools.description: Append new content (markdown or structured blocks) to an existing FuseBase page without overwriting existing content. Uses real-time Y.js WebSocket synchronization. Great for adding meeting notes, research updates, log entries, or checklists.

tools.name: update_page_content
tools.description: Write or replace content on a page using the native Y.js WebSocket protocol. Accepts markdown (recommended) or structured content blocks. Supports: headings (H1/H2/H3), paragraphs, bold, italic, strikethrough, underline, inline code, links, highlight, bullet/numbered/checkbox lists, dividers, blockquotes, code blocks (with language), toggles, hints/callouts, collapsible headings, images, files, bookmarks, remote frames, outlines, buttons, steps, tables, and grid layouts.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks in a workspace with full task details, assignees, labels, and board info. Optionally filter by page to see only tasks linked to a specific note. Supports pagination with offset and limit.

tools.name: list_task_lists
tools.description: List task lists (kanban boards) in a workspace with their associated tasks, assignees, and reminders. Optionally filter to a specific task list by ID. Task list IDs are needed for create_task.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in a workspace within a specified task list. Supports title, description, priority, due date, assignees, and labels. Use list_task_lists first to get valid taskListId values.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a task's properties — change status, priority, title, description, assignees, or due date. Uses PATCH semantics so only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: [DESTRUCTIVE] Delete a task permanently from a workspace. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: check_version
tools.description: Get server version and check for updates from GitHub. Returns the current installed version, latest available version, whether an update is available, and the command to update. If update_available is true, inform the user that a new version is available and suggest updating.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the local FuseBase guide documentation (231 guides across 17 sections). Returns matching guide titles, sections, and slugs. Use get_guide to read the full content of a specific result. Great for looking up how any FuseBase feature works.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get the full markdown content of a specific FuseBase guide by section and slug. Use search_guides first to find the right section/slug values. Returns the complete guide including instructions, screenshots, and hotkeys.

tools.name: list_guide_sections
tools.description: List all 19 FuseBase guide sections with the number of guides in each. Use this to browse available documentation categories before searching for specific topics.

tools.name: set_tool_tier
tools.description: Enable extended Fusebase tools for this session. By default only core tools (33) are loaded for performance. Call this with tier 'all' to dynamically register 103 additional tools (136 total) for admin, analytics, database CRUD, portals, ActivePieces automations, and CLI operations.

tools.name: get_labels
tools.description: Get all labels (colored categories) defined in a workspace. Labels have titles, colors, and styles, and can be applied to tasks for visual organization. Returns label IDs usable in task creation.

tools.name: get_org_usage
tools.description: Get organization-wide usage statistics including storage, traffic, member counts, AI credits, and workspace quotas. Each metric shows current vs max values. Useful for monitoring plan limits and resource consumption.

tools.name: get_comment_threads
tools.description: Get all comment threads on a specific page, including thread status (resolved/open) and nested comments. Useful for reviewing feedback, discussions, or collaborative annotations on a page.

tools.name: get_task_description
tools.description: Get the full rich-text description and detailed properties of a specific task. Use this when search_tasks provides insufficient detail. Returns the task's complete content including formatted description.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List all AI agents configured in the organization with their titles, descriptions, and types. AI agents are custom assistants created in Fusebase's AI features. Returns agent IDs and metadata.

tools.name: get_ai_assistant_state
tools.description: Get the workspace AI assistant state, prompt suggestions, assistant preferences, and recent chat threads.

tools.name: list_ai_agent_threads
tools.description: List active conversation threads and history for a specific AI agent in the organization.

tools.name: get_ai_agent_favorites
tools.description: Get favorited or bookmarked AI agents configured in the organization.

tools.name: get_agent_public_profile
tools.description: Get the public profile (title, description, avatar URL, workspace binding) for a specific AI agent model by its global ID.

tools.name: get_mention_entities
tools.description: Get all mentionable entities (users, pages, folders) in a workspace for @-mention autocomplete. Includes member counts, workspace structure overview, and owner info. Useful for understanding workspace scope at a glance.

tools.name: get_navigation_menu
tools.description: Get the full sidebar navigation tree showing all pages, folders, and their hierarchy across workspaces. Includes parent-child relationships, icons, and timestamps. Best way to get a complete structural overview of all content.

tools.name: get_activity_stream
tools.description: Get the activity feed for a workspace showing recent comments, @mentions, and content changes. Includes user avatars and note references for each activity item. Useful for monitoring workspace activity and collaboration.

tools.name: fusebase_poll_mentions
tools.description: Poll the Fusebase activity stream for new @mentions or comments directed at this profile. Use filterText to narrow results to only items mentioning a specific display name.

tools.name: fusebase_post_comment
tools.description: Create a new comment thread on a Fusebase page. The comment is anchored to a specific block (targetId) or to the page itself. Use this to leave feedback, ask questions, or communicate with human collaborators.

tools.name: fusebase_reply_comment
tools.description: Reply to an existing comment thread on a Fusebase page. Use get_comment_threads first to find the thread ID, then reply to continue the conversation.

tools.name: fusebase_resolve_thread
tools.description: Resolve (close) a comment thread after it has been addressed. Use get_comment_threads to find thread IDs.

tools.name: get_task_usage
tools.description: Get task usage statistics for a workspace, including upcoming deadline dates and active reminders. Useful for understanding task workload and scheduling pressure in a workspace.

tools.name: get_recently_updated_notes
tools.description: Get recently updated notes across the entire organization, not limited to a single workspace. Returns notes sorted by last modification time with pagination support. Useful for finding the latest activity org-wide.

tools.name: get_task_count
tools.description: Get the total number of tasks in a workspace as a single count. Lightweight alternative to search_tasks when you only need the quantity, not the task details.

tools.name: get_workspace_detail
tools.description: Get full workspace metadata including internal IDs, organization binding, creator userId, and creation/update timestamps. Provides deeper detail than list_workspaces. Useful for debugging or workspace administration.

tools.name: get_workspace_emails
tools.description: Get the email-to-note addresses for a workspace. Sending emails to these addresses automatically creates pages in the workspace. Returns the dedicated email address and associated user.

tools.name: get_file_count
tools.description: Get the total count of files stored across all workspaces in the organization, or in a specific workspace. Lightweight check for storage auditing — use list_files for detailed file listings.

tools.name: get_ai_usage
tools.description: Get AI feature usage for the organization showing current consumption vs maximum allowed. Tracks AI credits used across all workspaces. Useful for monitoring AI quota before heavy AI operations.

tools.name: get_org_permissions
tools.description: Get comprehensive organization permissions including all workspace memberships, role assignments, user avatars, and per-member usage data. More detailed than get_members — includes cross-workspace permission mapping.

tools.name: get_workspace_info
tools.description: Get workspace billing info including quota reset dates and plan details. Shows when usage counters reset and the organization's current billing cycle. Useful for understanding rate limits and renewal timing.

tools.name: get_note_tags
tools.description: Get tags applied to a specific page/note. Unlike get_tags which returns workspace-wide tag vocabulary, this returns only the tags on one particular page. Use for checking a page's categorization.

tools.name: get_database_data
tools.description: Get structured data from a Fusebase database/table view. Requires the dashboard UUID and view UUID, which can be found in the URL when viewing a database in the Fusebase UI. Supports pagination via page and limit parameters.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List all databases/dashboards in the organization. Returns dashboard and view UUIDs that can be used with get_database_data. Probes known entity types (spaces, clients) plus any custom entities you specify.

tools.name: get_database_entity
tools.description: Get data from a specific database entity type (e.g. clients, spaces). Automatically discovers the correct dashboard/view UUIDs for the entity. Supports pagination.

tools.name: create_database
tools.description: Create a new database (table or kanban view) in the organization. Returns the new database, dashboard, and view UUIDs. The database is created with a default table representation. Use list_databases afterwards to see it.

tools.name: add_database_row
tools.description: Add a new row to a database table or entity. Uses canonical batchPutDashboardData with create_new_row: true. You can optionally supply initial column values as a key-value map (using column display names or opaque item_keys).

tools.name: delete_database_row
tools.description: [DESTRUCTIVE] Delete a row from a database. Requires the dashboard ID and the row ID. Use get_database_rows to find row IDs.

tools.name: batch_put_database_data
tools.description: High-throughput batch create and update for database rows and cell values. Supports creating new rows (create_new_row: true) and updating existing rows (create_new_row: false, root_index_value: rowUuid). Values can use column display names or opaque item_keys. To delete a cell value, pass null.

tools.name: resolve_database_alias
tools.description: Resolve a system managed database or dashboard alias ('companies_db', 'deals_db', 'meetings', 'clients', 'spaces') to its database, dashboard, and view UUIDs. Useful for CRM and pipeline automation.

tools.name: link_database_rows
tools.description: Link two rows between related tables via an existing relation. Requires the relation ID, the source row UUID (from the source table), and the target row UUID (from the target table). Use list_database_relations to find relation IDs.

tools.name: unlink_database_rows
tools.description: Remove a link between two rows in related tables. If sourceRowUuid and targetRowUuid are omitted, removes all links for the relation.

tools.name: get_relation_rows
tools.description: Get active row link mappings for a relation. Shows which source rows are linked to which target rows.

tools.name: reorder_database_rows
tools.description: Reorder rows within a database view or section. Takes an array of { rowUuid, order } objects.

tools.name: move_kanban_card
tools.description: Move a kanban card to a different column by updating the grouped column's cell value. Equivalent to update_database_cell but semantically describes moving a card. Use get_database_schema to find the groupBy column key, and get_database_rows to find the row UUID.

tools.name: list_database_relations
tools.description: List available relation targets and existing lookups for a dashboard. Returns linked tables/views that can be used for creating relation or lookup columns.

tools.name: create_dashboard_table
tools.description: Create a new table (dashboard) within an existing database. Returns the new dashboard UUID and its default view UUID. Use list_all_databases to find the parent database ID.

tools.name: delete_relation
tools.description: [DESTRUCTIVE] Delete a relation by its ID. This removes the link between two database tables. Use list_database_relations to find relation IDs.

tools.name: list_all_databases
tools.description: List all databases in the organization via the dashboard-service REST API. Returns database metadata, dashboard (table) UUIDs, and view UUIDs. More comprehensive than list_databases — returns full database objects with nested dashboards.

tools.name: get_database_detail
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific database including all its dashboards (tables) and views. Use the database ID from list_all_databases or create_database.

tools.name: update_database
tools.description: Update a database's title, description, icon, color, favorite status, or public visibility. Uses PUT (PATCH is not supported by this API).

tools.name: delete_database
tools.description: [DESTRUCTIVE] Delete a database and ALL its dashboards (tables), views, and data. This action is irreversible. Returns 204 on success.

tools.name: get_dashboard_detail
tools.description: Get detailed information about a dashboard (table within a database). Returns the dashboard's views array (including custom views), metadata, root entity, and scopes. Use the dashboard ID from list_all_databases or get_database_detail.

tools.name: delete_dashboard
tools.description: [DESTRUCTIVE] Delete a dashboard (table) within a database. Removes the table and its data. Use get_database_detail first to see available dashboards.

tools.name: update_view
tools.description: Update a custom view's name, filters, sorts, or hidden columns. Use get_dashboard_detail to find available views. Uses PUT (PATCH is not supported).

tools.name: set_view_representation
tools.description: Switch a view's display mode. Supports 8 types: table (default spreadsheet), kanban (card columns), board, calendar, timeline, gallery, list, grid. Table and kanban use the representations endpoint; the rest use PUT with default_representation_template_id. Use get_dashboard_detail to find dashboard and view UUIDs.

tools.name: duplicate_database
tools.description: Duplicate (copy) an entire database, including tables, views, relations, and optionally data. Returns the new database with its UUIDs. Discovered via captured API: POST /databases/copy-from/database.

tools.name: create_view
tools.description: Create a new view within a dashboard (table). Each view can have its own filters, sorts, grouping, column visibility, and display mode. Use set_view_representation afterwards to change the view type.

tools.name: delete_view
tools.description: [DESTRUCTIVE] Delete a view from a dashboard. Cannot delete the default (first) view. Use get_dashboard_detail to find view UUIDs.

tools.name: export_csv
tools.description: Export a database view as CSV text. Returns the raw CSV content. Supports 5 delimiter options: comma, semicolon, pipe, tab, or caret. Use get_dashboard_detail to find dashboard and view UUIDs.

tools.name: duplicate_view
tools.description: Duplicate an existing view within a dashboard. Creates a copy with the same schema, filters, and configuration. Use get_dashboard_detail to find dashboard and view UUIDs.

tools.name: import_csv
tools.description: Import CSV data into an existing database table/view. Provide the CSV content, the database ID, dashboard (table) ID, and the view ID. The server will import the rows into the database. Column mapping is auto-generated from CSV headers (all imported as 'Single line text').

tools.name: set_view_grouping
tools.description: Set the grouping column for a kanban or board view. Groups cards/rows by the specified column. Requires the dashboard ID, view ID, and the column key to group by. Use get_database_schema first to find column keys.

tools.name: set_column_width
tools.description: Set the width of a column in a database view. Use get_database_schema first to find column keys. Width is in pixels.

tools.name: rename_database_column
tools.description: Rename a column in a database view. Updates the column's name in the view schema. Use get_database_schema first to find the column key.

tools.name: reorder_database_columns
tools.description: Reorder columns in a database view. Provide an array of column keys in the desired order. Columns not in the array are appended at the end. Use get_database_schema first to see current column keys and order.

tools.name: update_database_cell
tools.description: Set the value of a specific cell in a database row. Use get_database_rows or get_database_data first to obtain the rowUuid and the column key (short opaque string like 'eoZSNDPy'). The get_database_rows tool returns a schema array mapping column names to keys for easy lookup. Note: rich-text (Description), file, and relation columns may not accept plain string values.

tools.name: get_database_rows
tools.description: Get rows from a database view in a structured format optimised for agent use. Each row includes: rowUuid (needed for update_database_cell), cells (raw column key → value map), and namedCells (human-readable column name → value map). Wraps get_database_data with friendly field names and schema reflection.

tools.name: get_database_schema
tools.description: Get the column schema for a database view. Returns an array of column definitions with key (opaque 8-char ID, needed for update_database_cell), name (human-readable), type (string, number, date, label, checkbox, etc.), and edit settings. Use this to understand a database's structure before reading or writing cells.

tools.name: add_database_column
tools.description: Add a new column to a database view. Supported types: string (single-line text), multiline (multi-line text), number, date, label/status/select (with optional custom labels and colors), checkbox/boolean, email, phone, link/url, currency, files, user/assignee (assign org members), subtable/child-table-link (nested table). For relation columns use add_relation_column, for lookup columns use add_lookup_column. Returns the new column's key which is needed for update_database_cell. Use get_database_schema to verify the column was added.

tools.name: delete_database_column
tools.description: [DESTRUCTIVE] Delete a column from a database view by its key. Use get_database_schema first to find the column key. This removes the column definition from the schema — existing cell data for that column key will no longer be visible. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: add_relation_column
tools.description: Add a Relation column that links this database to another database table. This creates a cross-database relation (via POST /relations) and adds a lookup-source column. The column shows linked records from the target table. Use get_database_schema on the target table first to get its dashboardId and viewId.

tools.name: add_lookup_column
tools.description: Add a Lookup column that displays data from a related table through an existing Relation column. The lookup column is read-only and automatically pulls data from the linked records. You must have an existing relation column first (created via add_relation_column). Use get_database_schema to find the relation column key.

tools.name: get_org_limits
tools.description: Get the organization's plan limits including maximum members, storage, traffic, AI credits, workspaces, and other quotas. Use alongside get_org_usage or get_usage_summary to compare current consumption against plan caps.

tools.name: get_usage_summary
tools.description: Get a condensed snapshot of organization usage vs limits — lighter than get_org_usage. Returns current/max for overall usage, storage, and blots in a single response.

tools.name: list_portals
tools.description: List client portals for the organization. Optionally filter by workspace. Client portals are shared, branded pages published externally for clients or stakeholders.

tools.name: get_portal_pages
tools.description: Get pages published to a client portal. Returns the portal page tree for a given workspace, optionally filtered to a specific page. Use list_portals first to find active portals.

tools.name: create_portal
tools.description: Create a new client portal for a workspace. Client portals are external, branded spaces where external clients view published pages, widgets, and dashboards.

tools.name: get_portal
tools.description: Get detailed portal configuration, custom branding, access rules, greeting messages, and custom injected scripts for a portal.

tools.name: publish_page_to_portal
tools.description: Publish or unpublish an internal workspace page to the client portal by updating its is_portal_share flag.

tools.name: check_portal_availability
tools.description: Check whether the organization account has the client portal feature enabled and available.

tools.name: get_portal_theme
tools.description: Get client portal UI visual theme, dark/light branding colors, hero greeting banner, search bar settings, and sidebar options.

tools.name: get_portal_navigation_menu
tools.description: Get the complete hierarchical sidebar navigation tree and page entities published in a workspace's client portal.

tools.name: get_workspace_portal
tools.description: Resolve the primary client portal object bound to a workspace (portal ID, global ID, domain, creation timestamp).

tools.name: get_org_features
tools.description: Get feature flags enabled for the organization. Each feature has an ID, name, and enabled status. Useful for checking what capabilities are available on the current plan.

tools.name: create_interactive_app_page
tools.description: Create a new FuseBase page embedding a full-width interactive web application, widget, or dashboard (FuseBase Vibe Coding/Apps). Uses a remote-frame block with allowOverWidth=true.

tools.name: list_automation_flows
tools.description: List ActivePieces automation workflows configured in the FuseBase organization. Shows workflow IDs, names, status (enabled/disabled), and triggers.

tools.name: get_automation_flow
tools.description: Get detailed configuration and step definitions of an ActivePieces automation workflow.

tools.name: list_flow_runs
tools.description: List execution history of ActivePieces automation flow runs, including status, execution duration, and trigger timestamps.

tools.name: list_automation_pieces
tools.description: List available ActivePieces connectors, actions, and trigger pieces (e.g. piece-fusebase, piece-smtp, piece-webhook, piece-csv).

tools.name: fusebase_cli_status
tools.description: Check if the official FuseBase developer CLI (`fusebase`) is installed, detect its version, binary path, and authentication state.

tools.name: fusebase_cli_init
tools.description: Initialize a new FuseBase hosted app product in the specified directory using the official FuseBase CLI.

tools.name: fusebase_cli_list_apps
tools.description: List configured FuseBase hosted web applications and their URLs.

tools.name: fusebase_cli_deploy
tools.description: Deploy a FuseBase web application to production hosting via the FuseBase CLI.

tools.name: fusebase_cli_sidecar_add
tools.description: Add an auxiliary Docker sidecar container (e.g. headless Chromium, Redis cache, Lightpanda) to an app backend via the FuseBase CLI.

tools.name: fusebase_cli_sidecar_list
tools.description: List configured Docker sidecar containers for an app via the FuseBase CLI.

tools.name: fusebase_cli_sidecar_remove
tools.description: Remove a Docker sidecar container from an app via the FuseBase CLI.

tools.name: fusebase_cli_secret_create
tools.description: Register a platform application secret key for an app via the FuseBase CLI.

tools.name: fusebase_cli_secret_list
tools.description: List registered application secrets for an app via the FuseBase CLI.

tools.name: fusebase_cli_logs
tools.description: Retrieve remote deployment logs or local dev logs for a FuseBase app.

tools.name: fusebase_cli_app_update
tools.description: Update an existing app's configuration via the FuseBase CLI, including dashboard view permissions and build commands.

tools.name: create_automation_flow
tools.description: Create a new ActivePieces workflow automation in FuseBase.

tools.name: update_automation_flow
tools.description: Update an existing ActivePieces workflow automation (rename or toggle status ENABLED/DISABLED).

tools.name: delete_automation_flow
tools.description: [DESTRUCTIVE] Delete an ActivePieces workflow automation by flow ID.

tools.name: trigger_automation_flow
tools.description: Test-run or trigger an ActivePieces workflow automation with a custom JSON payload.

tools.name: list_portal_clients
tools.description: List invited external clients and members with portal access across the organization or for a specific portal.

tools.name: invite_portal_client
tools.description: Invite a customer or client into a FuseBase client portal with the Client Role.

tools.name: create_portal_magic_link
tools.description: Generate a 24-hour passwordless magic access link for a portal client.

tools.name: fusebase_swarm_init
tools.description: Initialize a multi-agent swarm state machine database in FuseBase. Supports 'standard' 4-stage Kanban or 'flow' for FuseBase Flow's official 8-phase lifecycle (Specify -> Clarify -> Plan -> Decisions -> Tasks -> Verify Gate -> Implement -> Review & Deploy) with product-owner and ai-developer roles.

tools.name: fusebase_swarm_task_transition
tools.description: Transition a swarm task across lifecycle stages (e.g. Backlog -> In Progress -> Review -> Done, or Flow 8-phase stages), record agent audit comments, and trigger next-agent handover.

tools.name: get_dashboard_templates
tools.description: Get managed dashboard and view representation templates (e.g. Kanban, Table) used for database representations.

tools.name: get_member_roles
tools.description: List user ID to role mappings across the organization (e.g. member, admin).

tools.name: get_workspace_members_v1
tools.description: Get granular v1 workspace member entities including globalId, addedByUserId, and creation/update timestamps.

tools.name: get_tasks_workspace_summary
tools.description: Get cross-workspace task overview and summary statistics across all accessible workspaces in the organization.

tools.name: get_billing_info
tools.description: Inspect billing credit balance, active coupon code redemptions (e.g. AppSumo), and redeemed coupon token history.

tools.name: get_user_preferences
tools.description: Retrieve user notification options (email and push triggers), web editor state variables, and last-opened workspaces.

tools.name: set_sidebar_collapsed
tools.description: Toggle or set the FuseBase web editor sidebar collapsed state.

tools.name: get_task_time_tracking
tools.description: Get time tracking estimates and recorded time history for a specific task in a workspace.

tools.name: get_automation_flags
tools.description: Get ActivePieces automation platform system configuration, version, edition (ce/ee), webhook prefix, and feature flags.

tools.name: get_workspace_premium_status
tools.description: Inspect workspace subscription tier, status, and plan expiration date.

tools.name: get_active_import_status
tools.description: Check the status and progress of ongoing data migration or import operations into a workspace.

tools.name: get_org_trials
tools.description: List active feature trial subscriptions and trial expiration records for the organization.

tools.name: get_database_entity_templates
tools.description: Get all master database and dashboard entity templates available in the organization (including All workspaces, All portals, All forms, Custom table, and All clients). Shows root_entity mappings and complete JSON schema definitions.

tools.name: list_ai_agent_categories
tools.description: List all available AI agent categories defined in the organization (such as Sales, Support, Development, Content, etc.). Returns category names, descriptions, and global IDs.

tools.name: list_automation_folders
tools.description: List all automation workflow folders configured in ActivePieces. Returns folder IDs, names, badge colors, and project associations.

tools.name: create_automation_folder
tools.description: Create a new workflow organization folder in the ActivePieces automation engine to categorize and group automation flows.

tools.name: delete_automation_folder
tools.description: [DESTRUCTIVE] Delete an automation workflow folder from ActivePieces. This unassigns any flows contained within the folder without deleting the flows themselves.

tools.name: get_automation_user
tools.description: Get the profile and identity details of the authenticated ActivePieces automation engine user (email, name, ID, platform associations).

tools.name: list_isolated_stores
tools.description: List all isolated PostgreSQL stores (databases) in the organization provisioned via FuseBase Gate.

tools.name: create_isolated_store
tools.description: Provision a new isolated PostgreSQL database in the organization via FuseBase Gate.

tools.name: query_isolated_sql
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query (SELECT) against a FuseBase PostgreSQL Isolated Store. Runs inside a READ ONLY transaction.

tools.name: execute_isolated_sql
tools.description: Execute a DML statement (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) against a FuseBase PostgreSQL Isolated Store. For schema DDL changes, use apply_isolated_sql_migrations instead.

tools.name: select_isolated_sql_rows
tools.description: Select rows from a table in a FuseBase PostgreSQL Isolated Store using structured filters and options.

tools.name: insert_isolated_sql_row
tools.description: Insert a single row into a table in a FuseBase PostgreSQL Isolated Store.

tools.name: batch_insert_isolated_sql_rows
tools.description: Insert multiple rows into a table in a FuseBase PostgreSQL Isolated Store in a single request.

tools.name: list_isolated_sql_tables
tools.description: List all user tables in a FuseBase PostgreSQL Isolated Store.

tools.name: apply_isolated_sql_migrations
tools.description: Apply a DDL schema migration bundle to a FuseBase PostgreSQL Isolated Store.

tools.name: fusebase_work_run_agent
tools.description: Run a task or send a prompt to an AI agent in FuseBase Work. Initiates an agent run thread or appends to an existing thread.

tools.name: fusebase_work_scrape_url
tools.description: Scrape and extract clean web content from a URL using FuseBase Work's hosted Firecrawl engine or web parser agent.

tools.name: fusebase_work_trigger_n8n
tools.description: Trigger an n8n workflow or automation flow in FuseBase Work with custom input parameters.

tools.name: fusebase_token_list
tools.description: List all FuseBase API tokens belonging to the organization / user with scopes, provisioning source, and expiry via FuseBase Gate.

tools.name: fusebase_token_create
tools.description: Create a new FuseBase API token with specified scopes and permissions (secret token returned only once) via FuseBase Gate.

tools.name: fusebase_token_get
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific FuseBase API token by its global ID via FuseBase Gate.

tools.name: fusebase_token_revoke
tools.description: Permanently revoke (soft delete) a FuseBase API token so it can no longer be used for authentication.

tools.name: fusebase_token_permission_catalog
tools.description: List all platform base permissions and service-owned permissions registered on the FuseBase Gate platform.

tools.name: fusebase_gate_whoami
tools.description: Query the authenticated token identity, tenant organization ID, custom domain, default workspace, and granted scopes/permissions from FuseBase Gate or Dashboards MCP.

tools.name: fusebase_direct_tool_call
tools.description: Execute any official upstream FuseBase Gate or Dashboards operation directly via the Streamable HTTP MCP bridge.
